state_shape.request: preprocessTinyMessage(prompt), or prompt cut to 10,000 characters when restated is true

semantics.prompt: User words in a Matt run: the text after User: on a skill start, or a later prompt. No skill body is included.
semantics.expected: A required Addon pick. The check flags mean P(yes) < 0.70; the runtime selects at 0.75.
semantics.allowed: A pick is acceptable either way; it is not an unexpected pick.
semantics.other: An Addon outside expected and allowed is flagged when mean P(yes) > 0.80.
semantics.baseline_selected: Mean P(yes) over 3 fresh direct POST runs with the final catalog (2026-10-12; session, benchmark-checklist, and principle-explain-the-number re-measured 2026-10-14; restated samples measured 2026-10-15), >= 0.75. Stored values round to 3 decimals.
semantics.baseline_borderline: Mean P(yes) in [0.70, 0.80], including scores that are also selected. Stored values round to 3 decimals.
semantics.restated: The prompt is a stored smol restatement of a mid-session talk, written once with the extension's in-your-own-words instruction and frame (ADR 0021). The check sends it as it is, cut to 10,000 characters.
